errors.text_span: The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting with Math at the top left and proceeding clockwise.
errors.evidence: The statement that the slices are arranged in descending order clockwise is incorrect. The sequence of percentages in clockwise order starting from 'Math' is 29.3%, 24.3%, 22.2%, 10.4%, 2.3%, 2.2%, and finally 9.3%. The last slice, 'Others (combined)' at 9.3%, is larger than the two slices preceding it, 'Planning' (2.3%) and 'Creative Writing' (2.2%), breaking the descending order.
